classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 23 owns browser storage policy, performance budgets, routing conventions and web delivery mechanics. Domain presentation, design system and mobile-native behaviour remain outside this phase.

areas.area: Routes and URLs are validated and browser-safe
areas.requirement: Route definitions require a path, URLs are validated for secure schemes, HTML is sanitized and a default CSP is explicit.

areas.area: Browser storage, offline queue and conflicts are explicit
areas.requirement: Service-worker/PWA configuration, offline actions, conflict resolution and file upload constraints are represented with invalid inputs rejected.

areas.area: Web accessibility and error recovery are modeled
areas.requirement: WCAG configuration, ARIA compliance, error boundaries and appropriate 403/404/500 pages are explicit and stack traces are not exposed by default.

areas.area: Web performance is measured against budgets
areas.requirement: Core Web Vitals are rated, bundle/initial-load budgets can fail, and SEO, compression and CDN configuration are represented.

areas.area: Browser and client platform vocabularies interoperate
areas.requirement: Browser families, support/PWA capability and device/runtime classification share the declared cross-platform vocabulary and fail closed for unsupported combinations.

areas.area: Edge, CDN and complete route enforcement remain unwired
areas.requirement: A deployed web boundary must apply storage, route-security and performance contracts; current evidence proves only the typed web libraries and unit suites.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
